workarounds.symptom: Whitespace-padded `HF_HUB_OFFLINE` turns a recoverable cache miss into a hard failure, although `huggingface_hub` still treats the process as online
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(vector-db): parse HF_HUB_OFFLINE the same way huggingface_hub does. Target files: backend/python/app/embedding_main.py, backend/python/app/services/vector_db/sparse_embeddings.py, backend/python/app/utils/env_utils.py. `_hf_hub_offline_enabled()` in `sparse_embeddings.py` decides whether `SparseEmbedder._build_model` may fall back to a download after a cache-only load fails. It parsed `HF_HUB_OFFLINE` differently from `huggingface_hub`, so the two could disagree about whether the process is offline. (Ref: https://github.com/pipeshub-ai/pipeshub-ai/pull/5966)

workarounds.symptom: nul.ts filename causes checkout failures when cloning on Windows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(nodejs): rename nul.ts so native Windows clones can check out the tree. workarounds.symptom: [BUG] A non-owner editor can turn an agent into a service agent that searches with the owner's access
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agents): only the owner or an administrator can turn an agent into a service agent. Target files: backend/python/app/api/routes/agent.py, frontend/app/(main)/agents/agent-builder/agent-builder-permissions.ts, backend/nodejs/apps/src/modules/api-docs/pipeshub-openapi.yaml. `PUT /api/v1/agent/{agent_id}` accepted `isServiceAccount: true` from anyone with `can_edit` on the agent. `check_agent_permission` grants `can_edit` to WRITER and ORGANIZER as well as OWNER, and the administrator check only ran when `serviceAcc... (Ref: https://github.com/pipeshub-ai/pipeshub-ai/pull/5395)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Empty Claude reply fails the run on the direct Anthropic transport (400)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(agent-loop): skip empty assistant turn when replaying history to Anthropic. Target files: backend/python/app/agent_loop_lib/transport/anthropic.py, backend/python/tests/unit/agent_loop_lib/transport/test_anthropic_coverage.py.
